newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Kuok to list Singapore property arm Allgreen.
newsitem.headline: Kuok to list Singapore property arm Allgreen.

text.p: Malaysian tycoon Robert Kuok has applied to list his property arm, Allgreen Properties Pte Ltd, on the Stock Exchange of Singapore, a spokesman for DBS Bank said on Friday.
He told Reuters that "in-principle approval is expected before the end of the year". DBS Bank is handling the application.
Allgreen's interest is mainly the development of residential properties in Singapore and owns about 340,000 square metres of land.
"The company is still dynamic as it will continue to expand and acquire more properties as and when opportunities arise," the bank spokesman said.
Allgreen's main asset is the Singapore $578 million Great World City commercial complex on the fringe of the Central Business District.
